notes.title: Oliver and Penello's final journey.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30214486/bcbbc796e54c4693bac5fc2282b546ccc4d66126.png[/img]

Oliver and Penello have been through a lot together and have appeared in short stories and as cameos in other games. Their journey was briefly continued in Solenars Edge II as well as Restoration X. But, their final stop will be in Exiori (Chapter 3). Which is out now!


There was an update planned for Restoration, but unfortunately it didn't go so well and the game broke during these changes. I was able to salvage and fix the game back to where it was before the new update. But, another attempt will not be made. Sadly, these things will not come out, but here is what was going to be added in;

Hello and welcome to an unplanned and surprise update of Restoration!

It's been a super long time since this game has been updated and in all honesty it didn't need to be. It's finished. However, after including Oliver and Penello in my new project, I decided to revisit Astrelia and make some tweaks and additions. Here they are:

-Changed Oliver and Penello's character sprites to
an original fit to match them. (No longer random looking sprites).

-Added in a secret boss; Craboid. (Euclyca Boss Music.)

-Added in a mini dialogue scene with Calcifur at
Phren Village to warn players not to save if a person
turns into a Nightmare.

-Changed the max level of Oliver and Penello from 16 to 20.

Look forward to Oliver and Penello coming to my brand new upcoming RPG; Exiori

On Itch.io: https://syukino.itch.io/exiori

Coming soon to Steam! (Keep an eye out!)

None of those changes will happen. But, I did remake Phren Village from scratch in Exiori and it's remastered. You'll be able to see Oliver and Penello again in there. Sorry for the let down and I hope you all are staying strong as can be this year.

Take care~

Deterioration, the planned upcoming prequel to Restoration where you play as nightmares turning humans into other nightmares, has been cancelled. The cancellation comes from a mountain of reasons, but mostly due to a huge lack of support, rough sales on the entirety of Team Syukino's games and not enough motivation. As much as I'd love to give out my heart and soul doing painstaking labor for pennies a day. It's just not fully functional for me to continue it. Restoration Facts:

1. The flying mushroom is a reference to a Shroom Face from Solenars Edge Rebirth and using it allows you to gain access to a secret optional place. Fighting Maria from Solenars Edge Rebirth is not apart of the main scenario in Restoration.

2. The "Credits" button at the title screen is how you quit the game. It is the "Exit Game" feature.

3. Fishing is not a mini game, it is one of the things required to do to make money to complete the challenges in Phren Village.

4. The intro and outros are designed to rhyme at the end of each sentence.

5. There are two endings.

6. Oliver can heal on the map with his magic.

7. You can save almost everywhere from the inventory menu.

8. There is a difficulty slider in options if the game is too easy or hard for you.

notes.title: Restoration Update v1.2!
notes.content:
Hello again, and welcome to an update to Restoration! There are a couple of new things here and there and I'd like to list some of them. First off I fixed some bugs here and there. Also here is a note of some things added:

1. A tutorial added in the beginning with a new playable character: Anna.
2. New Weapons, Monsters and Items.
3. A traveling merchant who is placed around Astrelia and can offer you rare equipment.
4. Some minor stat changes.
5. Two Secret Bosses.
6. Option to skip the opening story and/or speed it up by holding the action button.
7. Vechicle graphic changes.
8. And a few more goodies.
9. Price dropped from 3.99 to 2.99.

Also I'd like to announce: Restoration: Nightmare Chronicles. A free short story DLC that is non cannon but for pure entertainment.

Get it here!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/707330/Restoration_Nightmare_Chronicles/

*Trading Cards, Badges, Backgrounds and Emoticons have been made and will be available when steam lets me release.*

Let us go where the world takes us- Syukino

notes.title: Restoration Hotfix v1.1
notes.content:
First and foremost, Syukino is now Team Syukino and I am known as Syu-Syu, second;
I know I am a little late on announcing this, but it was implemented like two weeks ago. I fixed a few things here and there;

-I fixed a bug where nothing happened when you got to the final boss, preventing you from going forward and finishing the game.
-I had to remove the space invaders mini game because it caused the game to force you into a nightmare battle and made the challenge impossible to complete.
-I nerfed some damage of certain skills and at the same time boosted the damage of other skills.

*Keep in mind the game has two different endings, a good and a bad one.*

*Please remember the game has a diificulty slider, so adjust it to your specifications if you find the game too easy or too hard.

As always, let us go where the world takes us~
